title: ‘People We Meet on Vacation’ Star Tom Blyth Worries About Typecasting — But Has a Solution
summary: The 30-year-old actor, who rose to fame with ‘The Hunger Games,’ admits he has trepidation about starring in rom-coms or in big blockbusters: “It definitely always gives me pause before I do the job.”
tags: Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
